answer: The CNIL report suggests that the design of algorithmic systems should focus on enhancing human freedom and autonomy. It emphasizes the importance of creating interfaces that allow users to understand and control the algorithms' effects, thereby enabling them to make informed decisions. An example provided to illustrate this is the "Politoscope," developed by the Institut des Systèmes Complexes de Paris-Île de France. This tool allows the public to explore large datasets and see the activity and strategies of political communities on social networks, thereby giving users more control and understanding of the information presented to them.
